{{Bug|Heroes consider party members outside of the actual range.}}

==Trivia==
*"Never Give Up!" and "[[Never Surrender!]]" might be references to the catchline of the movie [[w:Galaxy Quest|Galaxy Quest]]: "Never give up. Never surrender!"
* The figure on the left of this [[skill icon]] is seemingly the same as the figure in [["Make Your Time!"]].
*The figure on the bottom of the icon is a female [[Necromancer Obsidian armor|necromancer wearing Obsidian Armor]].
*The Paragon in the icon appears to be wearing [[Paragon Elite Sunspear armor|Elite Sunspear armor]].
